title: bthci_evt: Fix up LMP feature dissection
description:
This patch addresses several bugs, inconsistencies, and formatting issues related to dissection of LMP features:

- Use correct page number for dissecting LMP extended features from "Remote Host Supported Features Notification" HCI event (i.e. page 1, which is the "Host Supported Features")
- Fix dissection of page 2 of LMP extended features
- Fix field names for "Park State" and "Broadcast Encryption" LMP features
- Standardize filter names for LMP features for host/controller support
- Standardize filter names for reserved bit fields of LMP feature mask
- Use full filter name for "Link Supervision Timeout Changed Event" LMP feature
- Clarify that bit 51 of LMP feature mask, "Secure Simple Pairing (Controller Support)", denotes controller support
- Always use FT_UINT8 type for multi-bit fields for reserved bits in LMP feature mask so all bit values are displayed
- Fix variable name typos, formatting issues, and inconsistent encodings in the function `dissect_bthci_evt_lmp_features`

AI-Assisted: no
